title: "How It Went on Gemini's 4th Day" – Washington Post, Aug. 25, 1965, p. A10
description: Washington Post clipping (page A10) giving a chronological, orbit-by-orbit account (40th–49th orbits) of the Gemini 5 crew's fourth day in space, compiled from news dispatches with times in Eastern Daylight Time. Entries include sighting of a Minuteman missile launched from Vandenberg Air Force Base, attempts to photograph ground targets near Laredo, Tex., and quoted air-to-ground exchanges with Houston. The clipping is pasted on a backing sheet in an irregular column layout.
